vb_textbox.text: 1st pick is completely random but if it is 4 or more, click it again when you see it. There do seem to be some tall hat colours that consistently produce very low score, tall purple hat was uselees for me. But maybe they change the patttern each contestant, I don't know. But try to work out if one gets consistenly low scores then avoid it. If one get 6 o above keep looking for it until it drops. You need to be looking for combination of tall or short hat, as well as colour!If you keep on picking the sam cheracter it seems to gradually reduce its score. But low ones seem to stay low so if say a tall brown hat gives only 1, then only 2 or 0, leave it alone.
